records.title: Piper: Towards Flexible Pipeline Parallelism for PyTorch
records.reason: Piper evaluates flexible PyTorch pipeline parallelism using Llama-3B/CLIP and reports training throughput. It gives no LLM inference-serving evaluation, leaving relevance indirect.

records.title: Latent Harmony: Synergistic Unified UHD Image Restoration via Latent Space Regularization and Controllable Refinement
records.reason: Latent Harmony addresses UHD image restoration and restoration quality, not language-model serving efficiency.

records.reason: SAMPO targets autoregressive motion generation for world models, not language-model token generation or LLM serving.

records.title: AHA - Predicting What Matters Next: Online Highlight Detection Without Looking Ahead
records.reason: The study detects online video highlights without looking ahead; it does not concern LLM inference.

records.reason: Residual compression accelerates parallel diffusion-model serving; its workload is diffusion generation rather than LLM serving.
